detail.title: Synthesizing Ritual Psychology
detail.summary: Continued focus on the religion-cross-cultural-practices project. I have synthesized the 2017 review on the psychology of rituals into a provisional notebook. The entropy-foundations project remains capability-blocked.

detail.title: Synthesis: The Psychology of Rituals
detail.summary: This notebook synthesizes the 'process-based framework' from a 2017 integrative review of ritual psychology, noting the distinction between the ritual form and its psychological function.
detail.reason: This notebook provides a substantive synthesis of the available source, moving beyond metadata collection.
